title: Pathogen-Oriented Low-cost Assembly & Re-sequencing (POLAR): A highly sensitive and high-throughput SARS-CoV-2 diagnostic based on whole genome sequencing
author: Per A. Adastra

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1) of sparQ PureMag beads to each sample well in plates Pool #1 and Pool #2 and mix gently by either flicking or pipetting. For example, add 50 µL sparQ PureMag beads to a 50 µL reaction. Then pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube.

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Place the plates on the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate and incubate for 00:02:00 or until the beads have pelleted and the supernatant is completely clear. Then, while avoiding the bead pellet, carefully remove the clear supernatant. SPRIPlate 96R Ring Super Magnet Plate (96-well Magnet Plate, Agencourt, A32782, https://www.beckman.com/supplies/plates/a32782 )

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Keeping on magnetic plate, add 200 µL of Room temperature 80 % volume, (freshly made) ethanol to the side of the well opposite to the pellet and let sit for 00:00:30 .

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Avoid disturbing the bead pellet, carefully remove and discard ethanol. Wait for 00:00:10 then remove any remaining ethanol.

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Add 20 µL of 10 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl (Ph 8.0) and pipette to mix well. Incubate for 00:02:00 at 37 °C .

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: go to step #19 and repeat ethanol wash.

steps_raw.title: Nextera Library Preparation
steps_raw.instruction: Make a master mix of the Tagment mix and Tagment Buffer for 96 samples (account for pipette error) and pipette to mix well. Aliquot 6 µL of the master mix into each well of a new 96-well plate and add 4 µL of 1ng Amplicon DNA.

steps_raw.title: Nextera Library Preparation
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 00:05:00 , then lower to 10 °C . Once at 10°C, immediately add 2.5 µL of Neutralizing Tagment Buffer to stop the reaction. Mix by pipetting up and down.

steps_raw.title: Nextera Library Preparation
steps_raw.instruction: Make a mastermix of the Nextera PCR Master Mix and Index Primers 1 and 2 for 96 samples (account for pipette error) and mix by pipetting. Aliquot 12.5 µL of this mastermix into each well of a new 96-well plate and add 12.5 µL of tagmented amplicon DNA from Step 35.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Place the plate on the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate and incubate for 00:02:00 or until the beads have pelleted and the supernatant is completely clear. Then, while avoiding the bead pellet, carefully remove the clear supernatant.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Add a 1:1.8 ratio of sparQ PureMag beads to each well and mix gently pipetting. For example, add 90 µL sparQ PureMag beads to a 50 µL reaction.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: While keeping on magnetic plate, add 200 µL of Room temperature 80 % volume, (fresh made) ethanol to the side of the well opposite of the pellet and let sit for 00:00:30 .

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Avoid disturbing the bead pellet, carefully remove and discard ethanol. Wait for 00:00:10 then remove any remaining ethanol.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Add 100 µL of 10 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl (pH 8.0) , vortex, and pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube. Incubate for 00:02:00 at 37 °C .

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1) of sparQ PureMag beads to each well and mix gently by pipetting. For example add 100 µL sparQ PureMag beads to a 100 µL reaction.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Separate beads on the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate and incubate for 00:02:00 or until the beads have pelleted and the supernatant is completely clear. Then, while avoiding the bead pellet, carefully remove the clear supernatant.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: While keeping on magnetic plate, add 200 µL of Room temperature 80 % volume, (fresh made) ethanol to the side of the well opposite of the pellet and let sit for 00:00:30 .

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Avoid disturbing the bead pellet, carefully remove and discard ethanol. Wait for 00:00:10 then remove any remaining ethanol.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: go to step #52 and repeat ethanol wash.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Add 20 µL of 10 millimolar (mM) Tris-HCl (Ph 8.0) and mix well by pipetting. Incubate for 00:02:00 at 37 °C

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Place the plate on the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate and incubate for 00:02:00 or until the beads have pelleted and the supernatant is completely clear. Then, while avoiding the bead pellet, transfer the 20 µL final library to a new plate for subsequent steps and storage.

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare the following reagents before starting viral RNA extraction: 1. Add beta-mercaptoethanol (user supplied) to the Viral RNA Buffer to a final dilution of 0.5 % volume i.e., 500 µL per 100 ml. 2. Add 192 mL of 100% ethanol (or 204 mL of 95% ethanol) to the 48 mL Viral Wash Buffer concentrate.

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: Mount the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate on a Collection Plate and centrifuge at 3000 x g, °C, - 5000 x g, °C, for 00:05:00 . Discard the flow-through from the collection plate.

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: Add 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer to each well and centrifuge at 3000 x g, °C, - 5000 x g, °C, for 00:05:00 . Discard the flowthrough from the collection plate. Repeat this step.

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: Add 500 µL ethanol (95-100%) to each well and centrifuge at 3000 x g, °C, - 5000 x g, °C, for 00:05:00 .

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: To elute RNA, mount a new 96-well plate between the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate and an empty Collection Plate. Add 15 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix of the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate wells and centrifuge at 3000 x g, °C, - 5000 x g, °C, for 00:05:00 . The eluted RNA extract will be collected in the middle 96-well plate.

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: Add 400 µL of Viral RNA Buffer to each sample well. Mix well by pipetting.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Remove a “Mid-Output Kit" reagent cartridge from -20°C freezer storage.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Place the cartridge right-side-up in a secondary container and fill the container with water at room temperature, but do not fully submerge the cartridge. Thaw cartridge in this water bath for about 01:00:00 .

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: When the reagent cartridge has been thawing for 00:30:00 , remove a "Mid-Output Kit" flow cell from the 4°C refrigerator but do not open the foil package. Place the flow cell on the bench for 00:30:00 to warm up to Room temperature

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: After the reagent cartridge is fully thawed, take it out of the water bath, tap on the bench to dislodge excess water, and dry with wipes.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Invert the cartridge to mix the reagents and make sure that the sequencing reagents in positions 29-32 are completely thawed. Then tap on the bench again to reduce air bubbles.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Remove the flow cell from its packaging and gently clean with a 70% ethanol wipe. Dry the glass with another wipe.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Inspect the flow cell to confirm: ports are free of obstructions, port gaskets are sealed and white plastic posts are visible, all 4 white retention clips are snapped over the edge of the black carrier plate and all 4 metal spring clips are laying flat against the black carrier plate.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Remove a tube of Hybridization Buffer (HT1) from the -20°C freezer and thaw at Room temperature . When thawed, place on ice.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: In a fresh 1.5ml tube, combine an aliquot from each library pool such that the total volume is 5 µL . For a Mid-Output kit, expect to obtain 150M reads in total.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Add 995 µL of ice-cold Hybridization Buffer (HT1). Vortex briefly and centrifuge at 300 x g, °C, for 00:01:00 .

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: In a fresh 1.5ml tube, combine 1203 µL of ice-cold Hybridization Buffer (HT1) and 97 µL diluted library for a final concentration of 1.5 picomolar (pM) . Invert to mix and pulse centrifuge. Place on ice until ready to load onto the reagent cartridge.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Part 3: Load the Sequencer Using a clean P1000 tip, poke a hole in the foil seal covering position 10 on the reagent cartridge (labeled “Load Library Here”). Avoid breaking any of the other seals on the cartridge: Finalized libraries are loaded in hole 10 of reagent cartridge.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Add the entire 1.3ml of the 1.5 picomolar (pM) library dilution into this reservoir.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: The reagent cartridge, flow cell, and buffer pack are now ready to be loaded onto the NextSeq500 for sequencing.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 10 µL supernatant from each well of the PCR plate to the corresponding well of a new midi plate.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Combine the following volumes in a 15 mL conical tube to prepare the LN master mix. Multiply each volume by the number of samples being processed: 23 µL of LNA1 and 4 µL of LNA2.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Pipette 10 times to mix and pour the LN master mix into a trough.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Use a p200 multichannel pipette to transfer 22.5 µL LN master mix to each sample well.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Seal the plate, and then use a plate shaker at 1800 rpm, °C, for 00:30:00

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Place on the magnetic stand and wait until the liquid is clear (~2 minutes). Without disturbing the beads, discard all the supernatant.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Wash two times as follows: Add 22.5 µL LNW1 to each well. Seal the plate, and then use a plate shaker at 1800 rpm, °C, for 00:05:00 . Separate on a magnetic plate and wait until the liquid is clear (~2 minutes). Without disturbing the beads, remove and discard all supernatant.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Add 15 µL 0.1 N NaOH to each well. Seal the plate, and then use a plate shaker at 1800 rpm, °C, for 00:05:00

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Add 15 µL LNS1 to each well of a new 96-well PCR plate labeled SGP.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: After the 00:05:00 elution completes, make sure that all samples in the midi plate are resuspended. If they are not, resuspend as follows:

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Pipette 10 times to mix or lightly tap the sample plate on the bench. Seal the plate, and then use a plate shaker at 1800 rpm, °C, for 00:05:00 . Place on a magnet rack and transfer 15 µL supernatant from each well of the midi plate to thecorresponding well of the SGP plate.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Seal the plate, and then centrifuge at 1000 x g, °C, for 00:01:00 .

steps_raw.title: RNA extraction
steps_raw.instruction: Collect 96 patient samples and record sample data. Add 200 µL of the samples into each well of the Zymo-Spin™ I-96 plate. Keep plate On ice while preparing reagents in Step 2.

steps_raw.title: Multiplex PCR
steps_raw.instruction: Add 2.5 µL of cDNA of each biological sample from from Step 11 to both Pool #1 and Pool #2 96-well plates.

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Separate beads on the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate for 00:02:00 or until the beads have pelleted.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Quantify the DNA concentration using the Qubit® High Sensitivity DNA kit from 1 µL of each product using Steps 26-35.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare a working solution by diluting the Qubit® dsDNA HS Reagent 1:200 in Qubit® dsDNA HS Buffer. For example, add 199 µL of buffer and 1 µL of dye per sample to a tube and vortex.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Add 190 µL of Qubit® working solution and 10 µL of the standard to each of the standards tubes and vortex.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: For each sample, add 199 µL of Qubit® working solution and 1 µL of the sample in each 0.5-mL sample tube and vortex.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Allow all tubes to incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: On the Home screen of the Qubit® 3.0 Fluorometer, press DNA, select dsDNA High Sensitivity, and press Read Standards to proceed.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Insert the tube containing Standard #1 into the sample chamber, close the lid, then press Read standard. When the reading is complete (~ 00:00:03 ), remove Standard #1.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Repeat Step 32 with Standard #2.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: To quantify samples, Press Run samples and select the sample volume ( 1 µL ) and units.

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Repeat Step 34 for all samples.

steps_raw.title: Post PCR Clean-up
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer supernatant from each biological sample in the two plates (Pool #1 and Pool #2) and combine into a single well per sample in a new 96-well plate.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: After PCR, bring up sample volume in each well to 50 µL with nuclease free water.

steps_raw.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps_raw.instruction: Separate beads on the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate and transfer 100 µL of supernatant to a new plate for a second round of cleanup.

steps_raw.title: Multiplex PCR
steps_raw.instruction: The following steps are performed in plates prepared according to the schematic below: Two 96-well plates are prepared for PCR such that each contains a mastermix with the corresponding primer pool and cDNA from each biological sample.

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Preheat an incubator to 98 °C

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 750 µL of diluted library to a new tube and add 750 µL of ice-cold Hybridization Buffer (HT1).

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Vortex briefly and centrifuge at 300 x g, °C, for 00:01:00 .

steps_raw.title: Loading the NextSeq550 sequencer
steps_raw.instruction: Place the tube on the 98 °C heated incubator for 00:02:00 and immediately cool on ice. Leave on ice for 00:05:00

steps_raw.title: Quantification of DNA concentration using a Qubit® High Sensitivity Kit:
steps_raw.instruction: Set up the required number of 0.5-mL tubes for standards and samples and label lids accordingly.

steps_raw.title: Nextera Library Preparation
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00 . Centrifuge at 280 x g, °C, for 00:01:00 .

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Place on a magnetic stand and wait until the liquid is clear ~ 00:02:00 .

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 15 µL supernatant from each well of the midi plate to the corresponding well of the SGP plate.

steps_raw.title: Library Normalization
steps_raw.instruction: Seal the sample plate, and then centrifuge at 1000 x g, °C, for 00:01:00 .
